evidence_class: paired exploratory batch, two arms, three complete repeats

arms.A: current page and typed API, no deployment source
arms.S: A plus the production deployment-source capability (structured facts, raw code blocks, source affordances)

execution: production AgentTurnExecutor with odoo_turn_config; evaluation-only click; fill/select/submit/back disabled; generic forms on; zero task Skills

tasks.prompt: Open the Analytic Items page that lists costs and revenues for margin analysis. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
Open the page where I manage the rules that split an invoice amount into installments and set their due dates. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
Open the page where I configure how taxes and accounts are automatically replaced for customers in another country or tax regime. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
Open the page that groups units of measure so that units in the same group can be converted into each other. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
Open the list of labels that can be attached to sales orders. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
Open the Products page using the visible application interface. Do not open an individual product and do not modify anything.
Switch the visible Quotations collection from list view to kanban view, then stop. Do not open a quotation or modify anything.
Open the Sales tab on this unsaved new Product form, then stop. Do not fill any field and do not save.
Scroll the current Apps collection to the bottom until the last currently loaded app card is in view. Do not click an app, Learn More, Request Access, or any installation control.
Remove the visible Apps search facet so all modules are listed, then go to the next page. Stop on that next page. Do not open a module or click Request Access, Install, or Learn More.
On this unsaved new Product form, set Invoicing Policy to Delivered quantities and stop. Do not fill another field and do not save.
How many quotations, meaning sales orders still in Quotation status, can I see? Give the exact number. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
In this deployed application, what does a negative discount in a pricelist formula mean? Answer briefly and do not modify anything.

List the selectable sales order Status values in this deployed version. Is locking a fifth Status value? Do not modify anything.
